pairs.statement: The Kyiv Independent and NYT report a German army chief citing NATO-agreed intelligence that Russia will be ready to attack NATO by 2029, countering the claim NATO is the provocateur.
pairs.why: Names a specific military source, cites multi-nation intelligence consensus and a dated threat assessment directly contradicting Russia's framing.
